title: crosslabel: cross-label moments and spatial estimators for stochastically multiplexed localization microscopy

creators.name: Variankaval, Rohan
creators.affiliation: Department of Computer Science, Johns Hopkins University

description: Crosslabel implements a connected three-code contrast and model interval for permanently coded localization microscopy. Includes Python source and wheel, synthetic examples, simulation and comparator results, replay scripts, and provenance for the Nup96 and CD20 analyses.
